algore_00.m: [This man smells of alcohol and some plant-like substance; he is clearly intoxicated]
r: I defeated the undead monster and opened the chest. I found a powerful sword inside.
I heard you were interested in that unattended treasure chest by the Waterway house.
Don't breathe on me! I'm leaving!

algore_01.m: Hey kid! Why don't you be a good little boy and fetch me some Lowyna's special brew?

algore_10.m: Oh yeah? What's it to you kid? ... BURP ... If you want to know, it will cost you two bottles of Lowyna's special brew.

algore_11.m:
Alright kid!
[Hagale immediately opens one of the bottles and takes a big swig, which he loudly swallows before wiping his mouth on the sleeve of his tattered shirt]
Yeah, I know something about that chest ... *burp* ... I almost opened it.

algore_20.m: I heard rumors about an unguarded treasure chest. I heard that the key that opened it, hung around the neck of an undead roaming the cemetery south of the chest. I also heard that the entrance to the cemetery was sealed by magic.

algore_30.m:
I thought nothing more of it. I was a simple trader in Loneford with a beautiful wife and daughter.
[Hagale takes another long swig from the bottle of Lowyna's special brew]

algore_31.m: That was until I had to travel to Remgard to purchase some new inventory. I normally make the trip alone. This time however, my wife and daughter decided to accompany me to Remgard.

algore_32.m:
We were only halfway there when we were attacked by Plaguestriders. My daughter and I managed to escape...
[Hagale takes another long swig from the bottle of Lowyna's special brew]
...but my wife did not survive.

algore_33.m: My daughter was afflicted by a nasty form of blistering skin. I rushed her back to Loneford. I thought with rest, good food, and water she could pull through ... but although the blisters were gradually healing, my daughter's health continued to decline.

algore_40.m:
[Hagale takes another swig from the bottle of Lowyna's special brew]
I realized that she wouldn't make it.
I watched as she suffered in agonizing pain. I knew without treatment she would die in a matter of weeks.

algore_41.m:
I had to do something. I went to Fallhaven and begged Thoronir to make me a bonemeal potion. Although it would have cured my daughter completely, he refused because Lord Geomyr banned all use of bonemeal as a healing substance!
[Hagale takes another long swig from the bottle of Lowyna's special brew and finishes it. He proceeds to open the second the bottle.]

algore_50.m: Still, I did not give up. I thought that if I opened the chest and gave its treasure as a gift to Lord Geomyr, I could plead with him to lift the bonemeal ban in time to save my daughter. It sounds stupid but I was desperate.

algore_51.m: I searched the land for information about the chest and graveyard. I spent my entire fortune in the process. My last few coins resulted in a tip that directed me to a group of bandits.

algore_60.m: A few days later, I tracked the bandits down. I begged and pleaded but they would not volunteer any information. They were obviously after the chest themselves, and they attacked me.

algore_61.m: I may be a trader, but traders have to learn how to protect themselves. The first few went down easily, but the leader was an experienced fighter. We fought for over an hour, but eventually I managed to kill him. I searched the body and found an ancient text.

algore_70.m: The text described a cemetery sealed by magic to contain a powerful undead monster roaming within it. My source was correct, it was a reference to the cemetery south of that chest.

algore_85.m: The ground began to tremble and darkness filled the sky. This was followed by a cracking sound, the loudest sound my ears ever heard, making a gust of cold air rush past me. Then, corpses began to claw their way to the surface. The odor ... it was putrid.

algore_86.m: Suddenly, a horde of undead attacked me. I fought them off as best I could but there were just too many. I barely escaped with my life and I never went back.

algore_86b.m: My daughter passed away shortly after I returned. I failed my wife and my daughter. I lost everything. I buried my family in Loneford, gave up my trade, and came here. Now, I drink Lowyna's special brew all day ... it helps me forget.
r: I'm sorry for your losses. You have suffered a lot. I want to finish what you started. Do you still have that text?

algore_87.m:
[Hagale finishes the second bottle of Lowyna's special brew]
Sure do. I hope you know what you're doing kid.

algore_99.m: You actually opened the chest? That sword must be worth a lot of money ... could buy a lot of Lowyna's special brew ... Sorry kid, but I need that sword!
r: I went through hell to get this sword. I won't give it to you without a fight.
I went through a lot to get this sword ... but you suffered more than me. I won't fight you. If you want it that badly, the sword is yours.
Yes, I have the sword, see here!
I did find the sword, but I don't have it anymore.
I'm sorry it has come to this.

algore_99b.m: Alright hand it over. Be quick about it.

algore_99c.m: Hey kid! Stop waving that thing at me! If you want to talk to me, put it away first!

algore_99e.m: Not too bright, are you kid? Perhaps you should go and pick it up again.

algore_99f.m: I gave you the text you needed to get that sword. I think some of that gold should be mine. If you don't give me some then I'll take it from you.
r: OK, OK. I guess it's fair that you should get a share. Here's {1000} gold.
No way! I fought to get the sword, and the profit is mine!

algore_99g.m: Thanks kid. It's good to see you have some honor.

algore_special.m: Thanks for letting me have the sword kid. I decided that with the money I can get for this I can rebuild my life. I'm going to sober up and start trading again. I'll be leaving here soon.

algore_special2.m: Thanks for the gold kid. I decided that with the money I can rebuild my life. I'm going to sober up and start trading again. I'll be leaving here soon.

algore_x81.m: The magical barrier at the cemetery could only be penetrated by someone carrying the text, which contained several magical inscriptions.

algore_x82.m: I took the best weapons and armor from the bandits, and made my way to the cemetery. Carrying the ancient text in my front pouch, I approached the entrance to the cemetery. I was only a few feet away when the text began to glow.

graveyard_quest.10: I stumbled across a treasure chest in a clearing south of the Waterway house but the chest is protected by some form of magic and cannot be opened.
graveyard_quest.20: I encountered a traveler a short distance from the treasure chest. He told me there is a legend that the key to the chest is held by one of the undead that roam the cemetery to the south of the chest. However, the entrance to the cemetery is sealed by a magical force.
graveyard_quest.30: The traveler told me that Hagale in the Wood settlement might know how to enter the cemetery.
graveyard_quest.35: I went to the Wood settlement and found Hagale. He was a drunk mess and would not speak to me unless I brought him two Lowyna's special brew.
graveyard_quest.40: Hagale said that the entrance to the cemetery was also sealed with magic to safeguard the key to the chest. The seal can only be broken by defeating the undead monster. However, Hagale found an ancient text that allows the holder to temporarily enter the cemetery. Hagale gave me the text.
graveyard_quest.50: I returned to the cemetery and was able to enter it using the ancient text just as Hagale had claimed.
graveyard_quest.60: I hacked through a horde of undead until I encountered one wearing a key.
graveyard_quest.70: I killed the undead and took the key.
graveyard_quest.80: I opened the chest, which contained a powerful sword. Next time I'm in the Wood settlement I should see if Hagale is still around.
graveyard_quest.90: Hagale tried to rob me and take the sword, but I killed him and took it back.
graveyard_quest.95: Hagale tried to rob me and take the sword. He lost his wife and daughter and wasn't thinking straight. I gave him the sword without a fight.
graveyard_quest.100: Hagale wanted some of the gold I got from selling the sword. It seemed fair to give him a share.
graveyard_quest.105: Hagale tried to rob me of the gold I got from selling the sword. I had no choice but to kill him.

sk.fightstyleUnarmedUnarmored: Fighting style: Way of the monk
